# Dracaena trifasciata (Prain) Mabb.

First published in Mabberley's Pl.-Book, ed. 4: 1101 (2017)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is S. Nigeria to W. Central Tropical Africa, Tanzania. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is used to treat unspecified medicinal disorders, has environmental uses and social uses and as a medicine.

## Distribution

  *   * KBD

### Native to:

Cameroon, Central African Republic, Congo, DR Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Nigeria, Tanzania

### Introduced into:

Andaman Is., Ascension, Bangladesh, Bermuda, Canary Is., Caroline Is., Chagos Archipelago, Comoros, Cook Is., Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, East Himalaya, Ecuador, Fiji, Florida, Galápagos, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, India, Jamaica, Leeward Is., Malaya, Marianas, Marshall Is., Mauritius, Mexico Southeast, Mexico Southwest, Myanmar, Nauru, Niue, Norfolk Is., Puerto Rico, Queensland, Rwanda, Réunion, Seychelles, Society Is., Solomon Is., Sumatera, Trinidad-Tobago, Tunisia, Vanuatu, Venezuelan Antilles, Wake I., Windward Is.
